findings.text: follow-on: _run_git_head duplicates the subprocess plumbing of _run_git - the same 10 s timeout, the same OSError and TimeoutExpired catches and two near-identical warning formats - instead of extending the existing owner at reckon/serve.py:1528, so a later change to the timeout or the failure contract in _run_git would silently not reach a HEAD lookup.

follow-on: the outside classification rests on the English substring not-a-git-repository in git's stderr, a message git ships for translation, so under a non-C locale a genuinely outside root would classify as failed and never be remembered, quietly restoring the one-failed-spawn-per-plan cost this node removed.
